sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(amount) AS total FROM table_name GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT name, metric FROM table_name ORDER BY metric DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM table_name GROUP BY category
SELECT group_field, AVG(metric) AS avg_metric FROM table_name GROUP BY group_field ORDER BY avg_metric DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM table_name
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() * 100, 1) AS percentage FROM table_name GROUP BY status
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY DATE(created_at) ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM table_name
